name: Rafale Pack Evolution III (Cuesta Brothers)
summary: Pack of Dassault Rafale A, S, B, C and M variants plus a tanker, flyable and AI.
description:
Rafale pack by the Cuesta brothers (Eric and Patrick): Rafale A, S, B, C, M and a 'Nounou' tanker variant, with player and AI weapon updates (SCALP, Exocet, AASM). Thread reports the Su-33 is needed (C/M variants); AS-30 use needs the Super Etendard pack. File named for DCS 2.9.28.

Requires: Super Etendard et Class Clemenceau pack needed for AS-30 use.
